text: Fair launch tokens outperformed centrally distributed projects during the late 2020 and early 2021 rally: the collective crypto average token launch gained 112.41% over 90 days while fair launch projects gained over 296%.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
abstract: During the digital asset market rally in late 2020 and early 2021, the collective crypto average token launch over 90 days increased 112.41%, while Fair Launch projects gained over 296%.
